texts: Day 212. The source code has a floor, and something lies beneath it. The $(item)Axiom Distiller$() boils reality down past its code to the axioms underneath, and condenses them into fragments.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 7$() machine.

What is an axiom? In mathematics, a statement accepted without proof - the bedrock every theorem is derived from. Change the axioms and you change what can be true. Holding a fragment of one is like holding a rule in my hand. It hums.

axiomatic_breach_engine.title: The Breach Engine
texts: Note to self: this machine breaks every law of physics and mathematics at once. While it runs, step into its heart and you fall out of reality.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 7$() machine.
Too complex for any crafting grid. I built this controller on the $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$() - check JEI for the exact parts; I needed every one of them.

Two ways through. Forge an $(item)Axiom Key$() here - it is reusable, and takes you to Hyperdimensional Reality Space and back. Or run $(thing)Open Breach$() and, while the engine runs, simply walk into its centre.
First crossing. Inside, reality shatters into shards that each obey different laws. I took a step and the rules changed under my boots. I am still not sure which laws I was standing in.
The Reality Compiler showed that the universe runs on source code. Beneath the code are $(thing)axioms$() - the rules that decide what can be true at all. Physics is just their consequence.

Real mathematics agrees there are cracks. Godel proved any consistent system rich enough for arithmetic holds true statements it cannot prove; Russell found a set that both is and isn't its own member. The axioms are not as solid as they look.

So, the plan. To leave reality you must break all of them at once: build $(item)Aleph-Null Shards$(), the $(item)Godel Sentence$(), $(item)Russell Paradox Sets$() and $(item)Banach-Tarski Spheres$(), fuse them into $(item)Absolute Infinity$(), then distil $(item)Axiom Fragments$() and open the $(thing)Axiomatic Breach$().

Cantor's trick, built in brass: list every number, then build one that differs from the n-th at its n-th digit - a number on no list. It manufactures infinities, then bigger ones.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 6$() machine.

It takes the computational power of a superintelligence and points it at infinity.$(br2)Odd result today: $(item)Banach-Tarski Spheres$() can be split and reassembled into two. In real maths that is a theorem, not a trick - the pieces are so strange that 'volume' stops applying to them.

concept_compressor.title: Singularity Compressor
texts: Log: the $(item)Conceptual Singularity Compressor$() takes whole stacks of everything a field of science has produced and compresses them into a single singularity of pure concept.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 6$() machine.
Too complex for any crafting grid. I built this controller on the $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$() - check JEI for the exact parts; I needed every one of them.

Each recipe eats whole stacks: nine slots of a field's products plus three tanks. Nothing here waits on a timer - it only costs what it costs. I fed it a decade of lab notes and it handed me back one glowing point.

The Omniscience Catalyst is made in the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$() from every singularity there is. Here, with cosmic neutronium or transfinite coils, catalysts are forged into $(item)Omnium$() far more efficiently than by hand. Lesson learned the slow way.
Every field ends the same way. The $(item)Conceptual Singularity Compressor$() takes whole stacks of everything it produced and compresses them into a $(item)Singularity$().
One for each field: $(li)mathematics$(li)the Standard Model$(li)spacetime$(li)stars$(li)dimensions$(li)time$(li)quantum$(li)cognition$(li)exotic matter

Four singularities plus the field capstones make the $(item)Theory of Everything$() - the unified theory physicists have chased for a century, sitting on my bench. That, the other five singularities, Absolute Infinity and the Omega Point fuse into the $(item)Omniscience Catalyst$().
The catalyst and stacks of every late-game metal make the $(item)Omnium Ingot$() - and the $(item)Omnilex$() is forged from four of them. It costs everything, but nothing here waits on a timer.

hyperreal.title: Outside Every Universe
texts: Log, first descent. Outside every universe there is a single, endless space. A $(thing)World Tree$() of an unknown material towers over it, more than four hundred blocks high.

Its branches spread for more than a thousand blocks in every direction, and every branch carries $(item)Bubble Universes$() - entire cosmoses, each the size of a fist. Break one to take a sample.$(br2)Eternal inflation predicts exactly this: pocket universes budding off a larger space. I never expected to pick one.

$(item)Arbor Heartwood$() does not behave normally. It drifts between four phases:$(li)dormant$(li)$(thing)inverted$() - gravity reverses for whatever stands on it$(li)$(thing)luminous$() - blazing light, and it hurries you along$(li)$(thing)unreal$() - no light at all, and things fall as if through syrup

Below the Tree lies the $(thing)Ocean of Primordial Law$(). Laws bubble up out of it and pop out of existence again; anything that swims in it obeys whichever law is in force at that moment. Strangely, it is breathable. I checked twice.
Note to self: it can be distilled. The Ocean yields $(item)Axiom Fragments$() and $(item)Crystallised Law$().

The last ingot is not hard because of one rare thing - it is hard because of $(thing)how much$() goes into it. The $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$() is a 9x9 crafting grid; JEI's "+" button fills it for you.

The $(item)Singularity Compactor$() swallows thousands of one material and squeezes them into a $(item)Material Singularity$(): 2,048 netherite, 8,192 diamonds, 65,536 redstone... There is no timer - it absorbs as fast as you (or pipes, or AE2) feed it, and remembers its progress.

Lattices of $(item)Cherenkov Lattice$() and nether stars make the $(item)Crystalline Matrix Ingot$(). Four "everything" items take one of every meat, every crop, a ring of ender pearls, and every music disc. Yes, every disc. I went looking.
Day 340, tallying. The $(item)Omniscience Catalyst$() takes one of every material singularity, the conceptual singularities, the four everything-items and more - roughly 587,776 raw items each.

The $(item)Omnium Ingot$() needs 16 catalysts, 32 Cosmic Neutronium, 16 Crystalline Matrix and an Omega Point in the 9x9 table.$(br2)With $(thing)cosmic neutronium coils$() the Conceptual Singularity Compressor forges one from 4 catalysts instead; with $(thing)transfinite coils$(), four.
A small indulgence. Working miniatures on pedestals: black and white holes, a wormhole, a pocket universe, a tesseract, a pulsar, a galaxy, a quasar, a Dyson sphere and a penteract.

They are drawn live, not painted. The ones that bend light (black hole, white hole, wormhole, pulsar) are the heaviest - their tooltips warn you. Only the nearest two dozen are drawn at once, so my shelf of forty never melts the renderer.
It simulates the World Tree and the Ocean of Primordial Law - and so controls them. Only works in Hyperdimensional Reality Space.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 8$() machine.
Too complex for any crafting grid. I built this controller on the $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$() - check JEI for the exact parts; I needed every one of them.

This engine will only run in $(thing)Hyperdimensional Reality Space$(), and is built partly from the World Tree itself. It simulates the $(thing)Tree$() and the $(thing)Ocean$() - first separately as $(item)Simulacra$(), then together.
A perfect model of a thing is, in the end, a handle on it. Whoever holds the resulting $(item)Omnilex$() is no longer bound by gravity.
The final goal: build the $(item)Omnilex Engine$() in Hyperdimensional Reality Space. Simulate the Tree as an $(item)Arbor Simulacrum$() and the Ocean as a $(item)Primordial Ocean Simulacrum$().
Then join them with an $(item)Omega Point$(). Tipler's Omega Point is the end-state where computation embraces everything - a fitting seal.$(br2)Hold the $(item)Omnilex$() and you may fly.

With the two simulacra the engine can grow new bubble universes, rewrite laws into crystals, or simulate everything that will ever be, down to the Omega Point.$(br2)Last entry for tonight. I am not sure there is anything left to discover. I am almost sure I am wrong.

Pour every fluid there is - water and lava too - into the $(item)Pleroma Confluence$(). It keeps a running total of each; when every one has reached a million mB, a thousand mB of $(item)Pleroma$() appears.
The old word means 'fullness': the totality of everything. Fitting. It accepts fluids from any pipe or AE2 on any side, and Pleroma can be drained from any side. Mine is fed by every tank I own.
